instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the messages my Telegram bot was sent into my own records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-telegram-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the updates waiting for the bot (messages and edited messages in chats, groups and channels it is in), keeps each chat as a conversation in your records and moves the offset past what it read so Telegram does not send it again.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
